thyrraxis_say_intro_0.text: Small things, crossing my sky on a thread of stone. Do you know how far down the bottom is?
thyrraxis_say_intro_0.heard: Small things, crossing my sky on a thread of stone. Do you know how far down the bottom is?

thyrraxis_say_pull_0.text: I am the wind that broke the mountains flat. Come and be weighed against it.
thyrraxis_say_pull_0.heard: I am the wind that broke the mountains flat. Come and be weighed against it.

thyrraxis_say_gale_0.text: Hold on to something. There is nothing here to hold.
thyrraxis_say_gale_0.heard: Hold on to something. There is nothing here to hold.

thyrraxis_say_squall_0.text: The storm walks. Find its door or be torn through it.
thyrraxis_say_squall_0.heard: The storm walks, find its door or be torn through it.

thyrraxis_say_conduit_0.text: Feed my pylon, little ones, or I will feed it with you.
thyrraxis_say_conduit_0.heard: Feed my pylon, little ones, or I will feed it with you.

thyrraxis_say_nova_0.text: Enough standing. Let us see how you fall.
thyrraxis_say_nova_0.heard: Enough standing. Let us see how you fall.

thyrraxis_say_updraft_0.text: Back up, then. The sky is not finished with you.
thyrraxis_say_updraft_0.heard: Back up then, the sky is not finished with you.

thyrraxis_say_rings_0.text: The rings are coming. Leap them, or be swept from my sky.
thyrraxis_say_rings_0.heard: The rings are coming, leap them or be swept from my sky.

thyrraxis_say_spark_0.text: A spark for you. Carry it far from your friends.
thyrraxis_say_spark_0.heard: A spark for you. Carry it far from your friends.

thyrraxis_say_break_0.text: This ground offends me. I will have none of it.
thyrraxis_say_break_0.heard: This ground offends me. I will have none of it.

thyrraxis_say_clouds_0.text: Rise and the clouds take you. Fall, and the void will have you.
thyrraxis_say_clouds_0.heard: Rise and the clouds take you. Fall and the void will have you.

thyrraxis_say_kill_0.text: Gone on the wind, like all the rest.
thyrraxis_say_kill_0.heard: Gone on the wind like all the rest.

thyrraxis_say_kill_1.text: Another leaf, torn from the branch.
thyrraxis_say_kill_1.heard: Another leaf torn from the branch.

thyrraxis_say_kill_2.text: Fly, then. You were never built for it.
thyrraxis_say_kill_2.heard: Fly then. You were never built for it.

thyrraxis_say_low_0.text: The sky does not bleed. It has never bled.
thyrraxis_say_low_0.heard: The sky does not bleed. It has never bled.

thyrraxis_say_wipe_0.text: Lie still. The wind will scatter what is left.
thyrraxis_say_wipe_0.heard: Lie still. The wind will scatter what is left.

thyrraxis_say_death_0.text: Even the storm must rest, at the last.
thyrraxis_say_death_0.heard: Even the storm must rest at the last.

kaldurra_say_intro_0.text: Come in out of the cold, children. I lit the first fire. Let me show you the last.
kaldurra_say_intro_0.heard: Come in out of the cold, children. I lit the first fire. Let me show you the last.

kaldurra_say_pull_0.text: Every hearth you ever warmed your hands at was a spark of mine. I want them back.
kaldurra_say_pull_0.heard: Every hearth you ever warmed your hands at was a spark of mine. I want them back.

kaldurra_say_wildfire_0.text: The fire walks. You will run out of island before it runs out of hunger.
kaldurra_say_wildfire_0.heard: The fire walks. You will run out of island before it runs out of hunger.

kaldurra_say_meteor_0.text: Catch, little one. It is still warm.
kaldurra_say_meteor_0.heard: Catch, little one. It is still warm.

kaldurra_say_flood_0.text: My blood is the sea now. Swim.
kaldurra_say_flood_0.heard: My blood is the sea now. Swim.

kaldurra_say_rings_0.text: Dance in my rings. I have always loved dancing.
kaldurra_say_rings_0.heard: Dance in my rings. I have always loved dancing.

kaldurra_say_seeds_0.text: Plant your little seeds. I will see what grows.
kaldurra_say_seeds_0.heard: Plant your little seeds. I will see what grows.

kaldurra_say_roar_0.text: Now the world will end. Hide, if you have somewhere to hide.
kaldurra_say_roar_0.heard: Now the world will end. Hide if you have somewhere to hide.

kaldurra_say_run_0.text: Down the length of you, all in one breath.
kaldurra_say_run_0.heard: Down the length of you, all in one breath.

kaldurra_say_crash_0.text: The ground came up to meet me.
kaldurra_say_crash_0.heard: The ground came up to meet me.

kaldurra_say_kill_0.text: Ash first, and then nothing at all.
kaldurra_say_kill_0.heard: Ash first, and then nothing at all.

kaldurra_say_kill_1.text: One less cold hand in the world.
kaldurra_say_kill_1.heard: One less cold hand in the world.

kaldurra_say_low_0.text: My fire is going out. Not yet. Not yet.
kaldurra_say_low_0.heard: My fire is going out. Not yet. Not yet.

kaldurra_say_wipe_0.text: Sleep now, children, where it is warm.
kaldurra_say_wipe_0.heard: Sleep now, children, where it is warm.

kaldurra_say_death_0.text: Keep the fire for me. Someone must.
kaldurra_say_death_0.heard: Keep the fire for me. Someone must.

morvekh_say_intro_0.text: I died here once. It was quiet. You have come to make it loud.
morvekh_say_intro_0.heard: I died here once. It was quiet. You have come to make it loud.

morvekh_say_pull_0.text: I remember every warm thing that ever froze. I will remember you.
morvekh_say_pull_0.heard: I remember every warm thing that ever froze. I will remember you.

morvekh_say_climb_0.text: Climb while you can. The cold is following you.
morvekh_say_climb_0.heard: Climb while you can. The cold is following you.

morvekh_say_breath_0.text: Breathe in. It is the last warm breath you take.
morvekh_say_breath_0.heard: Breathe in. It is the last warm breath you take.

morvekh_say_grasp_0.text: The grave reaches up. Hold fast, or come down to me.
morvekh_say_grasp_0.heard: The grave reaches up. Hold fast or come down to me.

morvekh_say_bombs_0.text: Stand behind your friends. They are colder than you now.
morvekh_say_bombs_0.heard: Stand behind your friends. They are colder than you now.

morvekh_say_deep_0.text: I will draw a white line across the world.
morvekh_say_deep_0.heard: I will draw a white line across the world.

morvekh_say_zero_0.text: When it reaches nothing, so will you.
morvekh_say_zero_0.heard: When it reaches nothing, so will you.

morvekh_say_grip_0.text: My grip is gone. I held so long.
morvekh_say_grip_0.heard: My grip is gone. I held so long.

morvekh_say_kill_0.text: You are still now. That is good.
morvekh_say_kill_0.heard: You are still now. That is good.

morvekh_say_kill_1.text: You will keep. The ice keeps everything a very long time.
morvekh_say_kill_1.heard: You will keep. The ice keeps everything a very long time.

morvekh_say_low_0.text: I remember dying. It was easier than this.
morvekh_say_low_0.heard: I remember dying. It was easier than this.

morvekh_say_wipe_0.text: Quiet again, as it should be.
morvekh_say_wipe_0.heard: Quiet again, as it should be.

morvekh_say_death_0.text: Warm. I had forgotten what warm was.
morvekh_say_death_0.heard: Warm. I had forgotten what warm was.

nihvaroth_say_intro_0.text: You have come to the edge of everything. Look down. That is where your gods went.
nihvaroth_say_intro_0.heard: You have come to the edge of everything. Look down. That is where your gods went.

nihvaroth_say_pull_0.text: I am the hunger under the stars. The other three were only my teeth.
nihvaroth_say_pull_0.heard: I am the hunger under the stars. The other three were only my teeth.

nihvaroth_say_devour_0.text: Come closer. Closer. Everything comes to me in the end.
nihvaroth_say_devour_0.heard: Come closer. Closer. Everything comes to me in the end.

nihvaroth_say_float_0.text: One of you is lighter than the others. I will take that one first.
nihvaroth_say_float_0.heard: One of you is lighter than the others. I will take that one first.

nihvaroth_say_spheres_0.text: These are pieces of nothing. Hold them if you dare.

nihvaroth_say_swallow_0.text: Into me. See what I have eaten.
nihvaroth_say_swallow_0.heard: into me. See what I have eaten.

nihvaroth_say_echoes_0.text: Meet my brothers again. They are mine now.
nihvaroth_say_echoes_0.heard: Meet my brothers again. They are mine now.

nihvaroth_say_cosmos_0.text: Your island is a crumb, and I am still hungry.
nihvaroth_say_cosmos_0.heard: Your island is a crumb, and I am still hungry.

nihvaroth_say_stunned_0.text: Something is in me. What have you done to me?
nihvaroth_say_stunned_0.heard: Something is in me. What have you done to me?

nihvaroth_say_nova_0.text: Your little stars. Watch them go out.
nihvaroth_say_nova_0.heard: Your little stars, watch them go out.

nihvaroth_say_ring_0.text: The edge comes in. It always comes in.
nihvaroth_say_ring_0.heard: The edge comes in It always comes in

nihvaroth_say_kill_0.text: Taken, and gone where nothing returns.
nihvaroth_say_kill_0.heard: taken and gone where nothing returns.

nihvaroth_say_kill_1.text: Nothing ever comes back from me.
nihvaroth_say_kill_1.heard: Nothing ever comes back from me.

nihvaroth_say_kill_2.text: Another light goes into the dark.
nihvaroth_say_kill_2.heard: Another light goes into the dark.

nihvaroth_say_low_0.text: I have never been empty before.
nihvaroth_say_low_0.heard: I have never been empty before.

nihvaroth_say_wipe_0.text: Hush now. There is no sound where you are going.
nihvaroth_say_wipe_0.heard: Hush now. There is no sound where you are going.

nihvaroth_say_death_0.text: So this is what it is, to be filled.
nihvaroth_say_death_0.heard: So this is what it is to be filled.
